policies.budget: go nodes plus depth; stop when either limit is reached. Depth allows a completed iteration; a node-cap interruption can still yield a rejected bound. Actual nodes are recorded and can overshoot the request.
policies.hash: Clear Hash then a distinct game object (ucinewgame/isready) per query
policies.history: Replay source initial_fen/history and require final FEN equality
policies.rejections: No replacement rows, no mate-to-CP conversion, no score clipping
policies.score: Last score-bearing info packet; white POV; exact CP only
